name: relay-ai
title: Relay AI
description: Your personal AI workspace: conversations, reusable prompts, and writing tools for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
author: jonathan-geva

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: ChatMock does not validate this, so 'chatmock' is fine.

preferences.name: defaultModel
preferences.title: Fallback Model
preferences.description: Used until you choose a default model with the Models command.

preferences.name: systemPrompt
preferences.title: System Prompt
preferences.description: Optional system prompt added to every conversation.
preferences.placeholder: You are a concise, helpful assistant.

preferences.name: saveHistory
preferences.title: Conversation History
preferences.label: Save conversations on this device
preferences.description: Disable to stop saving future conversations. Existing history can be deleted from the workspace.

commands.name: chat
commands.title: Relay AI
commands.description: Start conversations, browse prompts, and return to saved chats

commands.name: ask-selection
commands.title: Ask About Selected Text
commands.description: Ask AI about text selected in another app

commands.name: improve-writing
commands.title: Improve Selected Writing
commands.description: Review and improve selected writing, then copy or paste the result

commands.name: models
commands.title: Models
commands.description: Fetch models from the configured endpoint and choose a default

commands.name: prompts
commands.title: Prompt Library
commands.description: Reusable prompts for writing, summarizing, translating, and coding
